name: zc_christmas

tests.name: the two Christmas specs declare batches to look for
every batch the Christmas specs declare exists in the level

detail.note: an authored pass with a written spec and no instances placed reads as finished from the repository. That is the gap that had item 4 reported done while its material sat behind a console variable defaulting to off.

tests.name: the Christmas batches actually carry instances, not just names

detail.note: a batch with zero instances is as absent as one that does not exist, and is reported separately because the two mean different things to whoever fixes it.
